metadata.description: Lorcan's personal Claude Code plugin marketplace

plugins.name: review-management
plugins.description: PR lifecycle skills: describe-pr writes a conventional-commits title and humanised PR body from the raw diff vs base. handle-review processes incoming code review feedback — verify-before-implement, reasoned push-back, one item at a time, no performative agreement. Neither skill pushes, merges, or posts to GitHub.

plugins.name: humanize
plugins.description: Rewrite text and code to remove signs of AI-generated writing. Prose skill catches inflated significance, promotional language, em-dash overuse, AI vocabulary, bolded-header bullets, and sycophantic openers. Code skill renames verbose identifiers, simplifies comments and docstrings, and cleans up log / error / user-facing strings for non-native English readers.

plugins.name: tech-docs
plugins.description: Write technical docs (architecture overviews, feature designs, runbooks, getting-started guides, READMEs, tech-debt notes, how-tos, implementation plans, RFCs, and more). Asks the doc type and audience first, runs targeted clarifying questions one at a time, then drafts in plain language with structured markdown and pastel mermaid diagrams where they help. Output is humanised, with no AI tells.

plugins.name: git-management
plugins.description: Local-only git workflow skills for stacked branch development. stack-splitter breaks a large branch into a chain of independently mergeable stacked branches via cherry-pick. stack-rebase rebases an entire chain atomically using git rebase --update-refs (git >= 2.38). Never pushes or writes to remote.
